Open data. A clearer perspective.

This atlas explores 100 Sentinel‑2 Level‑2A scenes returned by Element 84 Earth Search for Sri Lanka (79.5–82° E, 5.8–9.9° N), January 1–31, 2025. It is a bounded catalog sample, not a complete inventory.

The AWS connection: scene thumbnails and original Cloud‑Optimized GeoTIFFs are delivered directly from the public sentinel-cogs Amazon S3 bucket in us-west-2. S3 makes the imagery accessible without copying large raster files or requiring an AWS account. Earth Search supplies the searchable STAC metadata; Leaflet draws geographic footprints on an OpenStreetMap basemap.

Colors indicate whole-scene cloud percentage, not conditions at a specific point. Footprints may overlap and extend beyond Sri Lanka. These are archived observations, not a live weather forecast. RGB bands have 10 m resolution; previews are downsampled thumbnails.

Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2025), processed by Element 84. Dataset, terms & attribution ↗ · STAC collection ↗

Snapshot retrieved October 31, 2026. No personal data. Export preserves scene IDs, geometry, dates, cloud cover, and AWS asset links.
